items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: I said, well, George, you know, you're not going to play the clarinet? He said, Dad, I don't care to play the horn.

ctx.x: And that's where, it was on, um, that was 1943. Yeah. Is that the place on, um, St. Bernard? St. Bernard, yeah. Yeah, the H and J Tavern. The H and J Tavern.

Yeah, that's it. That's the place. Well, I bought this clarinet for my son. So, he got to learn a little bit of horn at these. Learned pretty good, you know. And so he went to California with the horn. And then he came back again. And so, I noticed he wasn't bothering with it. I said, well, George, you know, you're not going to play the clarinet? He said, Dad, I don't care to play the horn. I said, well, no. I said, no. I said, well, I can't let it lay here and go to waste. So, I used to take that horn and my…
Oh, yeah, you got to work in the albert now.
